name: Oblique strategies
author: pcppcp
description: Shift + help shows the clock or a random card from Brian Eno and Peter Schmidt's Oblique Strategies, whichever you looked at last. Press Shift + help again to switch between them. A new card turns up each time you switch to it.
credits: Cards by Brian Eno and Peter Schmidt; idea and card screen from ultralazr's op1-oblique-strategies
